answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the tundra of a task receipt, and the velvet is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. The design leans on time-locked work history, burned when the recruit misbehaves, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. The opal of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
